properties.description: Every presented output byte matches an already accepted input prefix, or zero padding justified by completion of a short input frame.
Presented last markers match the padded or truncated output boundary. A boundary not yet established by accepted inputs cannot establish success.
Presented status responses independently follow completed input-frame order and report original length, clamped length, padding and truncation.
Blocked data and status channels independently preserve valid and payload until transfer or reset.
Synchronous reset clears both response valids and cancels outstanding epoch obligations without clearing historical violations.

The final-post marker combinationally checks completion without another clock edge: input and response valids must be idle, no partial accepted frame may remain, and both independent response queues must be consumed. Unknown observations or exhausted tracking cannot establish success.
